description: This file renders the quick compose frame for the email UI in SuiteCRM. It initializes the EmailUI object, calls its method to generate the HTML content for the email compose frame, and then outputs the resulting content after managing output buffering.

classes.name: EmailUI
classes.description: A class responsible for handling email-related UI components, specifically the quick compose email frame.

methods.name: displayQuickComposeEmailFrame
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the quick compose email frame used in the user interface.
